summary: The alternative and its proof are valid. The counting estimate applies to the actual convex superlevels even when they are not closed, the normalization preserves all original lattice weights, and both the large-width core estimate and the fixed-direction tail estimate establish the stated constants with all boundary points included. Degenerate supports, zero radii, d = 1, the first dyadic level reaching one, and the case a times tau equals one introduce no exceptions.
